settings.appearance.click_links_detail: Click a link to open it. When off, use ⌘-click.
settings.appearance.click_links_detail_c: Click a link to open it. When off, use Ctrl+click.
settings.appearance.copy_on_select_detai: Copy selected text when you release the mouse.
settings.appearance.hide_pointer_detail: Show it again when you use the mouse.
settings.appearance.last_folder: Open new terminals in the last folder
settings.appearance.last_folder_detail: Start where your last terminal was, instead of the project folder.
settings.appearance.paste_protection_det: Ask before pasting multiple lines into a shell or text with control characters.
settings.appearance.shell_integration_de: Mark zsh and bash prompts and command results in new terminals. Applies to terminals opened after the change.
settings.appearance.theme_drop_hint: Or drop a Ghostty theme or .itermcolors file here
settings.appearance.theme_error_format: not an iTerm2, Ghostty or diri theme
settings.appearance.theme_error_too_larg: too large to be a theme
settings.appearance.theme_error_write: couldn’t save it to diri’s themes folder
settings.appearance.title: Appearance
settings.phone.code_warning: This code grants control of your sessions. Treat it like a password. Paired phones stay paired when access is turned off and on again; New pairing code disconnects them all.
settings.phone.intro_awake: Keep Diri running and your Mac plugged in with its lid open. The display can turn off; closing the lid or choosing Sleep disconnects your phone.
settings.phone.intro_setup: A one-time setup, with no commands, router settings or addresses to type.
settings.phone.scan_hint: In Diri on your iPhone, tap Scan pairing code. We’ll check the connection before saving it.
settings.phone.step_iphone_detail: Open Diri on your iPhone. Its setup guide links to Tailscale in the App Store. Sign in there with the same account as {machine} and allow the VPN connection.
settings.phone.step_mac_detail: We’ll check whether Tailscale is ready. It keeps the connection between your devices private.
settings.phone.stopped: Phone access stopped. Disable it and enable again.
settings.phone.tailscale_needs_approval: This Mac needs approval from your Tailscale administrator. Ask them to approve it, then check again.
settings.phone.tailscale_needs_login: Tailscale is installed. Open it and sign in with the account you’ll use on your iPhone.
settings.phone.tailscale_not_installed: Install Tailscale on this Mac. It creates a private connection to your iPhone, even away from home.
settings.phone.tailscale_ready: Tailscale is connected on this Mac. Next, connect your iPhone using the same account.
settings.phone.tailscale_sign_in: In Tailscale, follow the setup prompts and sign in. Diri never asks for your Tailscale password.
settings.phone.tailscale_stopped: Tailscale is signed in but disconnected. Open its menu and turn it on, then check again.
settings.phone.tailscale_unavailable: Diri couldn’t confirm the Tailscale connection. Open Tailscale, finish its setup and check again.
settings.phone.title: Phone access
settings.remote.confirm_remove: Remove {name}? Existing sessions must be moved first.
settings.remote.empty_detail: Add any machine you can reach over SSH.
settings.remote.error_endpoint: Use a node endpoint like tcp://100.64.0.2:7337.
settings.remote.error_node_pair: Enter both the node endpoint and its local token file.
settings.remote.error_ssh: Enter an SSH destination, such as you@forge.
settings.remote.error_ssh_spaces: The SSH destination cannot contain spaces.
settings.remote.host_in_use: Move or close every session on this host before removing it.
settings.remote.now_default: {name} is now the default execution host
settings.remote.reinstall_failed: Could not reinstall the remote environment on {name}
settings.remote.reinstalling_detail: Uploading and verifying the packaged diri-remote build, then refreshing the remote environment checks. Running sessions are not interrupted.
settings.remote.setting_up_detail: Connecting with SSH, verifying diri-remote, loading the login environment, and testing session persistence.
settings.remote.title: Remote
settings.remote.token_hint: The token stays in that owner-only file. SSH remains available for install and recovery.
settings.remote.transport_note: Diri uses your SSH configuration without changing the host. Private-network and Tailscale names work transparently when OpenSSH can resolve them.
settings.resources.frozen_note: Frozen sessions are never killed. Opening one wakes it immediately, exactly where you left it.
settings.resources.hibernate_detail: Freeze a session once it has sat idle, with no output or CPU activity, for this long.
settings.resources.memory_limit_detail: Freeze an idle session when its process tree reaches this size.
settings.resources.title: Resources
settings.terminal.file_links_detail: The editor a clicked file path opens in.
settings.terminal.shell_command_custom: Runs {command} directly, without a shell. Remote hosts use their own shell.
settings.terminal.shell_command_login: Your login shell. Remote hosts always use their own.
settings.terminal.shell_command_placehol: zsh -l, nix develop, tmux new -A -s main
